div.p: baseline/ is standard issue: arrives at every start, loses to a file the user already has, and stays in the bucket.
deploy/ is a hand-off: drained while the session runs, wins over what is there, and is deleted once delivered — so it arrives once, not every minute.
home/ is a MIRROR, not a drop box. Uploading into it does not give the user the file: it looks exactly like a file they deleted, so the next save removes it again. Use deploy/.
Both inputs are copied by a process that has dropped to uid 1000, so a crafted archive cannot write outside the user's home directory.
